players.product: Xiyun C500/C600 training-inference GPGPU boards and modules (plus Xisi N inference GPUs), GPU servers and supernode/cluster solutions with the MXMACA software stack

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (unaudited): operating revenue RMB 1,323,593,726.74, up 44.67% YoY from RMB 914,930,984.35, which the company attributes to significantly higher GPU product shipments as customers kept buying. Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 612,449,523.30 (a turnaround), driven mainly by fair-value gains of RMB 887,073,872.02 on financial assets; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -48,859,468.32, loss narrowed 75.83%.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 1,323,593,726.74 (+44.67%); recurring net loss RMB -48,859,468.32

quarterly_data.signal: Products: Xisi N100 inference GPU entered mass production in April 2023, Xiyun C500 training-inference GPU in February 2024 and Xiyun C600 in May 2026. The C600, built on an all-domestic process, passed the national security and reliability evaluation; the company says it is expected to become its next main product. MetaXLink supports 2-128 card interconnect topologies and supernode architectures; GPU products are in commercial use in thousand-card clusters with larger cluster projects being pursued.

Deployment: products are deployed at scale in multiple AI computing centers serving AI computing platforms, telecom operators and commercial AI computing centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Changsha and Hong Kong. During H1 2026 the company signed a strategic cooperation agreement with China Unicom's Shanghai branch on GPU use in computing clusters and computing networks, and with Cloud Factory Technology is building a domestic GPU ecosystem center and large-scale domestic compute cluster in Wuxi. Revenue by channel: direct RMB 856,957,597.17, distribution RMB 466,636,129.57; Mainland China RMB 1,323,098,925.14.

Supply chain: the company says US government policy restricts its access to advanced-node wafer foundry and raw-material supply, and some suppliers are scarce and hard to replace domestically in a short time; it started a domestic supply chain early and designed products on the domestic supply chain. To secure raw-material supply it built strategic stock: prepayments RMB 2,196,145,680.56 at June 30, 2026 (+163.24%), mainly prepaid purchases; inventory RMB 1,431,886,053.14.

R&D expense RMB 524,807,347.16 (+15.28%), 39.65% of revenue; 747 R&D staff. Operating cash flow RMB -1,296,860,816.31, which the company attributes to the recurring loss, collections lagging revenue recognition and the strategic stock build.

MetaX.why: Chinese GPGPU designer selling Xiyun C-series training-inference GPU boards, servers and clusters for AI training and inference; revenue (RMB 1,323,593,726.74 in H1 2026, +44.67%) comes from GPU shipments, so its stock tracks AI training/inference GPU demand.
MetaX.evidence: MetaX 2026 half-year report: main business is R&D, design and sale of full-stack GPU products for AI training and inference; Xiyun C500 (mass production February 2024) and C600 (May 2026) training-inference GPUs deployed in AI computing centers.
